rationale.overall: A and B are near-identical renders of the same curled-page composition, but B's marginally softer, more diffused surface shading reads slightly closer to the REFERENCE's translucent, light-transmitting material, so it edges ahead.
rationale.material: Neither take reproduces the REFERENCE's frosted volumetric translucency — both are flat-lit glossy paper — but B's gentler highlight falloff on the white sheet and less hard-edged specular streak on the orange face is a touch nearer the reference's soft internal light.
rationale.silhouette: Both present the same rounded-square plaque with an identical folded-corner triangle and stepped-line mark, and neither carries the reference's freestanding tilted-cone form, so the silhouettes are indistinguishable.
rationale.smallsize: The 128/32/16px strips are visually identical, with the same orange wedge holding the read and the same loss of the stepped glyph by 16px.
